title: 第17章 苏晚晴赐宝冷月涵 我酸啊第18章 男人绝对不能说不行
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
苏晚晴微微颔首，似乎并不将此事放在心上。
“嗯，有用就好。”
她目光落在李玄身上，语气平淡地说道：“你炼制的丹药，本就根基不凡，为师只是稍作提点，能有此奇效，亦是你自身悟性过人之功。”
“不过……”
她话锋一转，神色严肃起来：“我辈丹修，虽以丹道为本，但身处修仙界，只知道炼丹，是万万不可的。”
“切记，修行界中，终究是实力为尊！”
“丹药终究是外物，纵使你现在能够用金刚丹，召唤出练气大圆满的金刚，却终究不是你自身的力量。”
“自身的强大才是一切的根本！”
李玄闻言，心中一凛。
他自然知道，苏晚晴说的一切都是好心，乃是老成持重之言，当即躬身道：“谨遵师尊教诲，弟子明白。”
苏晚晴点点头，眉眼中闪过一抹笑意，继续端正道：“你如今已是练气四层，根基也算稳固，不宜一味闭门苦修。”
“宗门任务大殿有不少适合练气期弟子历练的任务，你可去挑选一二，下山走走，见识一下山外的风土人情，与人斗法切磋，对你日后的修行，大有裨益。”
“是！”
看到师徒二人说的差不多，一旁的冷月涵忽然上前一步，对着苏晚晴盈盈一拜，声音轻柔婉转：“晚辈冷月涵，拜见苏峰主。”
“今日得见苏峰主仙颜，实乃三生有幸。”
李玄：？
这还是那个一言不合就拎着自己后领，为了一点灵石斤斤计较的网瘾冷月涵？
此刻的冷月涵，身姿窈窕，举止端庄，就连说话的语调都变得轻柔了许多，活脱脱一个知书达理、温婉可人的大家闺秀！
“苏峰主，晚辈自小便常听家师提起您的传奇事迹。”
冷月涵的语气充满了崇敬：“家师常说，苏峰主乃是丹道万古第一人，心怀苍生，泽被宗门，不仅丹术超绝，修为亦是深不可测，是我辈女修当之无愧的楷模与偶像！”

她滔滔不绝地讲述着自己对苏晚晴的仰慕之情，什么“丹道明珠”、“青云之光”、“谪仙人”之类的赞美之词不要钱似的往外冒，听得李玄在一旁都有些脸红。
苏晚晴显然被冷月涵这一通发自肺腑的彩虹屁捧得心情极好，脸上的笑容愈发温和，眼中甚至带着几分长辈对晚辈的慈爱。
“呵呵，你这孩子，倒是会说话。”
苏晚晴轻笑一声，从储物镯中取出一个玉瓶，递给冷月涵：“你此次大比表现不俗，又即将突破筑基，这枚极品筑基丹，便赠予你，助你一臂之力。”
“极品筑基丹？！”
冷月涵失声惊呼，凤眸瞬间瞪得溜圆，激动得差点当场跳起来，声音都恢复了几分平日里的豪迈：“多谢苏峰……呃，多谢峰主厚赐！”
她猛地反应过来，连忙收敛了外露的激动，努力维持着“淑女”人设，双手接过玉瓶，再次对着苏晚晴深深一揖，只是那微微颤抖的指尖，还是暴露了她内心的狂喜。
李玄在一旁看得目瞪口呆，心中五味杂陈。
不是……
这就送一枚极品筑基丹？
那可是有价无市的宝贝！
寻常筑基丹都一丹难求，更遑论能大幅提升筑基成功率，且毫无丹毒副作用的极品筑基丹！
早说啊！
我也可以舔的！
而且，我才是您唯一的亲传弟子啊！
亲徒弟啊！
苏晚晴似乎看穿了李玄心中那点小九九，转头看向他，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑容：“徒儿，你可是觉得为师偏心了？”
李玄连忙摇头：“弟子不敢。”
“呵呵。”
苏晚晴淡笑道：“你与月涵不同。”
content_en:
Su Wanqing nodded slightly, seemingly not taking this matter to heart.
"Well, as long as it's useful."
Her eyes fell on Li Xuan and she said in a calm tone: "The elixir you refined has an extraordinary foundation. I just gave you a few tips as a teacher. It can have such a miraculous effect because of your own extraordinary understanding."
"But..."
She changed the topic and her expression became serious: "Although we, alchemists, are based on alchemy, we are in the world of cultivating immortals and we only know that refining alchemy is absolutely forbidden."
"Remember, in the world of spiritual practice, strength is ultimately the most important thing!"
"Elixirs are foreign objects after all. Even if you can use the Vajra Pill to summon the Vajra of Qi Training, it is not your own power after all."
"Your own strength is the foundation of everything!"
When Li Xuan heard this, his heart trembled.
He naturally knew that everything Su Wanqing said was well-intentioned and was mature and prudent. He immediately bowed and said: "I will follow the teachings of my master. I understand."
Su Wanqing nodded, a smile flashed across her brows, and she continued to say straightly: "You are now at the fourth level of Qi training, and your foundation is solid. It is not appropriate to practice hard behind closed doors."
"The Zongmen Mission Hall has many missions suitable for Qi training period disciples. You can choose one or two, go down the mountain for a walk, experience the customs and customs outside the mountain, and compete with others. It will be of great benefit to your future practice."
"Yes!"
Seeing that the two masters and apprentices were talking about the same thing, Leng Yuehan on the side suddenly took a step forward, bowed to Su Wanqing, and said in a soft and melodious voice: "Junior Leng Yuehan, pay your respects to Master Su."
"To see the beautiful face of Master Su Feng today is truly a blessing."
Li Xuan:?
Is this still the Internet addict Leng Yuehan who grabs her by the collar whenever she disagrees and haggles over a few spiritual stones?
At this moment, Leng Yuehan has a slim figure and a dignified manner. Even her tone of voice has become much softer. She looks like a well-educated, gentle and pleasant lady!
"Master Su, I have often heard my master mention your legendary deeds since I was a child."
Leng Yuehan's tone was full of reverence: "My master often said that Master Su Feng is the first person in the alchemy path in all eternity. He has a heart for the common people and benefits the sect. Not only is his alchemy skills superb, but his cultivation is also unfathomable. He is a well-deserved role model and idol for the female cultivators of our generation!"
She talked endlessly about her admiration for Su Wanqing, and complimentary words such as "Pearl of Alchemy", "Light of Qingyun", "Exiled Immortal" were poured out as if they were free, which made Li Xuan blush a little.
Su Wanqing was obviously in a good mood because of Leng Yuehan's rainbow fart from the bottom of her heart. The smile on her face became gentler, and her eyes even showed a bit of love from the elders to the younger ones.
"Haha, you kid is really good at talking."
Su Wanqing chuckled lightly, took out a jade bottle from the storage bracelet, and handed it to Leng Yuehan: "You performed well in this competition and are about to break through the Foundation Establishment. I will give you this top-quality Foundation Establishment Pill to help you."
"The best foundation-building pill?!"
Leng Yuehan exclaimed, her eyes widened instantly, and she almost jumped up on the spot with excitement, her voice regained a bit of its usual boldness: "Thank you Su Feng... uh, thank you Peak Master for the generous gift!"
She reacted suddenly, quickly suppressed her exposed excitement, and tried hard to maintain her "ladylike" persona. She took the jade bottle with both hands and gave Su Wanqing a deep kiss again, but her slightly trembling fingertips still exposed the ecstasy in her heart.
Li Xuan was stunned as he watched from the side, with mixed feelings in his heart.
No...
Are you going to give me a top-quality foundation-building pill?
That is a priceless treasure!
Ordinary foundation-building pills are hard to find, let alone a top-quality foundation-building pill that can greatly increase the success rate of foundation-building and has no side effects of erysipelas!
Tell me earlier!
I can lick it too!
Moreover, I am your only direct disciple!
Dear disciple!
Su Wanqing seemed to see through the little Jiujiu in Li Xuan's heart. She turned to look at him with a hint of interest in the corner of her mouth.A profound smile: "Disciple, do you think your master is partial?"
Li Xuan quickly shook his head: "Disciple doesn't dare."
"Haha."
Su Wanqing smiled lightly and said, "You are different from Yue Han."
